g.text: Nearby — Sequence Diagram: Registration, Sign-in and Access Tokens
[a code was sent less than a minute ago]
202 — same answer for a registered phone
[no code, expired, used or 3 failed attempts]
markUsed — false if another request used it first
— a dummy hash for an unknown phone
issue(guest caller with a random id)
key by kid; HS256 only; signature;
iss, aud, typ at+jwt; not expired;
Errors: AuthService throws a DomainError with a code; ApiExceptionFilter (api) turns it into the status shown.
Token: header {alg HS256, kid, typ at+jwt}; claims sub, role, sid (accounts only), iss/aud nearby-api, iat, exp.
Keys: JWT_KEYS_FILE (JWK Set, first key signs) and CODE_HMAC_KEY_FILE, read at startup; a missing or short key stops the server.
Planned, not shown: refresh tokens and a revocation check by sid (SEC-005), lockout and rate limits (SEC-007), audit records (SEC-004).
